mapper.sql: select fi.invoice_id, fi.invoice_no, fi.invoice_code, fi.invoice_direction, fi.invoice_type, fi.source_order_id, fi.source_order_no, fi.target_id, fi.target_name, fi.tax_rate, fi.total_amount, fi.amount_without_tax, fi.tax_amount, fi.invoice_date, fi.status, fi.void_reason, fi.remark, fi.create_by, fi.create_time, fi.update_by, fi.update_time from fin_invoice fi
mapper.select: order by fi.invoice_date desc, fi.invoice_id desc

select ifnull(sum(case when fi.status = 'issued' and fi.invoice_direction = 'sale' then fi.total_amount else 0 end), 0) as saleTotalAmount, ifnull(sum(case when fi.status = 'issued' and fi.invoice_direction = 'sale' then fi.tax_amount else 0 end), 0) as saleTaxAmount, ifnull(sum(case when fi.status = 'issued' and fi.invoice_direction = 'purchase' then fi.total_amount else 0 end), 0) as purchaseTotalAmount, ifnull(sum(case when fi.status = 'issued' and fi.invoice_direction = 'purchase' then fi.tax_amount else 0 end), 0) as purchaseTaxAmount, ifnull(sum(case when fi.status = 'red_void' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as voidCount from fin_invoice fi
mapper.insert: insert into fin_invoice ( invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_direction, invoice_type, source_order_id, source_order_no, target_id, target_name, tax_rate, total_amount, amount_without_tax, tax_amount, invoice_date, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceCode}, #{invoiceDirection}, #{invoiceType}, #{sourceOrderId}, #{sourceOrderNo}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{taxRate}, #{totalAmount}, #{amountWithoutTax}, #{taxAmount}, #{invoiceDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update fin_invoice set status = 'red_void', void_reason = #{voidReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where invoice_id = #{invoiceId} and status != 'red_void'
